customManagers.description: Bump ARG MM_VERSION in the Dockerfile from Mattermost's GitHub releases.

packageRules.description: Bump MM_VERSION, the runtime base image and the OIDC submodule together — they must land in one PR. separateMajorMinor:false keeps a major bump on the same branch as the submodule's digest update, which has no major/minor of its own.
Matched by manager, not name: a submodule's packageName is its clone URL, not its path, so matchPackageNames can't reach it.
Go minor follows Mattermost's go.mod; bumped during an MM upgrade, not automatically.
